sample.description_md: One row per physical sampling event at its native grain (site, tow, net, subsample, cast, bottle, water, filter, underway, transect, sighting, deployment, scan, region pool). An adjacency list: `parent_sample_key` points at the containing event and `root_sample_key` at the top of the chain, so counting distinct events at any level is a single `GROUP BY`.

obs.description_md: The occurrence-headline long table: one scalar measurement per row, environmental (`realm = 'env'`) and biological (`realm = 'bio'`) together. Biological taxon is the global `taxon_key`; sub-occurrence detail (length/stage bins, behavior) lives in `obs_attribute`, and event-level effort in `sample_measurement`.

obs_ctd_full.description_md: Supplemental full-resolution CTD scans, identical in shape to `obs`. Excluded from the default table list and the ERD because of its size; opt in with `cc_get_db(supplemental = TRUE)`. The default `obs` carries CTD via the adaptively thinned `ctd_thin`.

measurement_type.description_md: reference table for CTD measurement types with units and descriptions

measurement_type.is_canonical.description_md: TRUE for canonical measurement types kept in ctd_thin and ctd_summary

measurement_type._source_column.description_md: original column name in wide-format CTD CSV

measurement_type._source_table.description_md: provenance: wide-format DuckDB table the measurement was pivoted from

measurement_type._source_datasets.description_md: provenance: semicolon-delimited list of datasets that produce this measurement type

measurement_type._qual_column.description_md: provenance: quality flag column name in source wide-format table (blank if none)

measurement_type._prec_column.description_md: provenance: precision column name in source wide-format table (blank if none)

obs.obs_id.description_md: Surrogate key, renumbered globally when the release concatenates the per-dataset shards.

obs.realm.description_md: `env` for physical/chemical measurements, `bio` for organism observations.

obs.sample_key.description_md: The sampling event this observation came from; joins `sample`.

obs.grid_key.description_md: CalCOFI station grid cell, denormalized from `sample` so rollups need no join. NULL for region-pooled data.

obs.cruise_key.description_md: Cruise, denormalized from `sample` so rollups need no join.

obs.datetime.description_md: Observation time (UTC). NULL for region-pooled data with no event time.

obs.depth_max_m.description_md: Deepest depth this observation represents; equal to `depth_min_m` for point measurements (bottle, CTD scan).

obs.taxon_key.description_md: Global taxon key, `worms:<AphiaID>` or `itis:<TSN>` for birds. NULL for `env` rows. Joins `taxon`.

obs.life_stage.description_md: Life stage where the source resolves one (larva, adult, juvenile, egg, phyllosoma).

obs.measurement_value.description_md: The measured value, in the units `measurement_type` declares.

obs.hex_id.description_md: H3 cell at resolution 10, stored as UBIGINT. Aggregate coarser at query time with `h3_cell_to_parent(hex_id, res)` — there is no per-resolution column ladder.

sample.sample_key.description_md: Globally unique event key, namespaced `dataset_key:sample_type:id` so the same integer id in two datasets — or at two event levels in one dataset — never collides.

sample.sample_type.description_md: Event grain: `site`, `tow`, `net`, `subsample`, `cast`, `bottle`, `water` (an eDNA water sample), `filter` (an eDNA water filter), `underway`, `transect` (a visual-survey effort segment), `sighting`, `deployment` (a sonobuoy), `scan` (one analysed hour of a recording) or `region_pool`.

sample.parent_sample_key.description_md: The containing event (net → tow → site; bottle → cast; sighting → transect; scan → deployment). NULL at the top of the chain. Flat adjacency list: attributes are not inherited.

sample.root_sample_key.description_md: Top of this event's containment chain; equals `sample_key` for single-level datasets. Use `count(DISTINCT root_sample_key)` to count stations/casts irrespective of grain.

sample.grid_key.description_md: CalCOFI station grid cell. NULL where the dataset has no station assignment (region-pooled phytoplankton).

sample.site_key.description_md: CalCOFI station natural key as the source records it (line/station, e.g. `090.0 060.0`). Present on 13 of the 18 source event tables, so it is carried on the event dimension rather than lost to consolidation; `grid_key` is the derived grid cell, this is the source's own station id.

sample.order_occ.description_md: Order in which the station was occupied on the cruise. Source spelling varies (`order_occ`, `ord_occ`) and CTD stores it as text; normalised to an integer here.

sample.depth_min_m.description_md: Shallowest depth sampled by this event.

sample.depth_max_m.description_md: Deepest depth sampled by this event; for swfsc_ichthyo tows and nets the maximum possible depth of the net (SWFSC Net.NetDepth, nominal: over a shallower sea floor the net did not reach it).

sample.tow_type.description_md: Net gear code where the dataset records one (C1/CB/CV/PV oblique or vertical, MT manta); NULL for gears and datasets without one. Needed to compute gear-appropriate CPUE.

sample.data_stage.description_md: The source's own processing state for this event: `final` (post-cruise calibrations applied) or `preliminary` (**not for publication** — the source warns that oxygen, nitrate and chlorophyll may change significantly once calibrated). Populated by `calcofi_ctd-cast`; NULL where the dataset draws no such distinction, which is not a claim that the data are final.
